name: hermes-vps-browser
description: Hermes Desktop plugin: shows the backend's own browser screen in the right sidebar.

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.jsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=react --external:@hermes/plugin-sdk --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* VPS Browser for Hermes Desktop. Source: src/plugin.jsx in this repo (bundles noVNC 1.7.0, MPL-2.0). */" --outfile=vps-browser/plugin.js
